definitions.explanation: A question word asking about time. Used to inquire when something happens, happened, or will happen.

examples.japanese: いつ{日本|にほん}に{来|き}ましたか？
examples.english: When did you come to Japan?

examples.japanese: いつでも{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}です。
{夏休|なつやす}みはいつからいつまでですか？
examples.english: When does summer vacation start and end?
examples.notes: いつから = from when, いつまで = until when

examples.japanese: いつか{日本|にほん}に{行|い}きたいと{思|おも}っていますが、いつ{行|い}けるか{分|わ}かりません。
examples.english: I want to go to Japan someday, but I don't know when I'll be able to go.

notes:
いつ is one of the essential question words (5W1H) used to ask about time.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- いつから: from when, since when
- いつまで: until when
- いつ〜ても: whenever

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
- いつも: always
- いつか: someday, sometime
- いつでも: anytime
- いつまでも: forever, indefinitely

NOTE:
Unlike {何時|なんじ} (what time), いつ asks about dates or general timing rather than specific clock time.
